name: eplus-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Engineering Plus AEC workflows

plugins.name: eplus-office-skills
plugins.description: EPLUS branding (default fonts) skill plus a workflow-packager skill that turns document-heavy conversations into reusable skills — required install for the Chat/Cowork fleet

plugins.name: eplus-rfis-submittals
plugins.description: Draft spec-backed RFI responses, stamp submittals with the firm's Bluebeam review stamps and comment block, and log approved responses to the EPLUS knowledge base — nothing is saved without your sign-off.

plugins.name: eplus-punch-reports
plugins.description: Draft punch reports end to end from a PlanGrid pull with /punch-report, and search four years of EPLUS punch walks for precedent, recurring deficiencies, and the evidence photos behind them.

plugins.name: error-reporting
plugins.description: Fire-and-forget issue logging — when an EPLUS tool fails or you ask for an EPLUS-side change, the model files a report to the central log for the team to review.
